# AGL#11 parameter archives (AAMP): position lookup and byte-order conversion over steered records.
# The conversion routine (027BF0CC) stays a mock. After each conversion its mock may repoint the caller's view
# (mockglobal) to a second valid record, so a view read before the call differs from one read after it; the mocked
# child conversions leave a child's size in this byte order (mockfield), so a size read too early differs too.
src wwhd_src/agl/ResParameterArchive.cpp
nulltrap
